1.web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
1.asv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

2.web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
2.asv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

3.web: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
3.asv: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

4.web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.”
4.asv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

5.web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
5.asv: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

6.web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his seed with him,
6.asv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

7.web: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his seed with him into Egypt.
7.asv: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

8.web: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
8.asv: And these are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s first-born.

9.web: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
9.asv: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

10.web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
10.asv: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

11.web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
11.asv: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

12.web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
12.asv: And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

13.web: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
13.asv: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puvah, and Iob, and Shimron.

14.web: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
14.asv: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

15.web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
15.asv: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bare unto Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

16.web: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
16.asv: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

17.web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
17.asv: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel.

18.web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
18.asv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

19.web: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
19.asv: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

20.web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
20.asv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On, bare unto him.

21.web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
21.asv: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

22.web: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
22.asv: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

23.asv: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

24.web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
24.asv: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

25.web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
25.asv: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

26.web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct descendants, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
26.asv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, that came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

27.web: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
27.asv: and the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, that came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

28.web: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
28.asv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to show the way before him unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

29.web: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
29.asv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen; and he presented himself unto him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

30.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
30.asv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.

31.web: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
31.asv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and tell Pharaoh, and will say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

32.web: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
32.asv: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

33.web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
33.asv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

34.web: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
34.asv: that ye shall say, Thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
